Vault encryption using Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) working correctly
Firewall middleware with 300 req/min rate limit implemented
Admin System panel fully functional with health monitoring, provider hot-swap, and system actions
Direct viewer-to-viewer gifting via recipient_id parameter working

seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created during testing for banking, earnings, and gifting tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All View/Clip iteration 4 enterprise features tested and working. New features include: 3-layer DB architecture (viewclip_identity, viewclip_streaming, viewclip_vault), AES field-level encryption for banking info in vault, Level-3 firewall middleware with 300 req/min rate limit, Admin System Control Panel (health monitor, hot-swap providers, deploy/reload/rotate actions, events + audit log), default View/Clip promos seeded on startup, Originals hero strip on Browse page, direct viewer-to-viewer gifting via recipient_id, and earnings endpoints accessible to all users. Stripe Connect and streaming provider activation remain mocked.
